rationale: Classical matrix invariant theory already treats trace-based conjugation invariants, and the central-simple-algebra literature treats conjugacy in a setting with reduced trace and norm. The broad claim is known. A publishable candidate must state a narrower system-specific theorem or a new synthesis; it must not present trace/norm conjugation compatibility itself as novel.
